entity.name: How to book Dubai’s air taxi
entity.meta_description: Booking will run through the Uber app: 'Uber Air powered by Joby' appears as a trip option and one tap books every leg. Not bookable yet as of August 2026 — no official waitlist exists. Launch expected before end of 2026.
